mentions.name: Workout Coach App
mentions.description: A personal coach app that generates workouts for the user; it has become solid enough to outperform the trainer the author previously had and now mainly receives occasional bug fixes and small fun additions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I continue to update my coach app that generates workouts for me. It’s really solid at this point, better then the trainer I had, so mostly occasional bug fixes now or silly additions.
mentions.author: bix6
